h1: Rayong Marriott Resort & Spa — beachfront on Wang Kaew Beach, Rayong's place for a proper unwind
intro: Most people think of Rayong as a stopover on the way to Koh Samet · but over in Klaeng district lies Wang Kaew Beach — a long, clear, far quieter stretch of sand than the famous beaches — and Rayong Marriott Resort & Spa is the 5-star Marriott resort sitting right on it · sprawling grounds, three saltwater pools (including a 35-metre lap pool), spacious sea-view rooms (205 of them), and a private beach you walk straight onto from the resort · from approximately ฿3,500/night.
galleryAlts: Outdoor pool at Rayong Marriott stretching toward the Gulf of Thailand
Sea-view room at Rayong Marriott with a private balcony overlooking the beach
The resort's private Wang Kaew Beach, long sand and clear blue water

body.html: Rayong Marriott opened in 2013 on a large beachfront plot at Wang Kaew Beach, Chak Phong, in Klaeng district — a fair drive from Rayong town but not far from the pier to Koh Samet · The first thing guests mention is the sheer size of the grounds and the long, quiet private beach · This isn't a beach lined with restaurants or streams of passing tourists, but the resort's own stretch of sand you can wander down to straight from your room.

There are 205 rooms in total, from Deluxe garden- and ocean-view rooms up to Premier Panoramic rooms and suites · Most rooms are larger than the typical 5-star standard, with a sitting area, work desk, mini fridge and a private balcony · The high-floor ocean-view rooms are the firm favourite in reviews for their full Gulf of Thailand outlook · Upper categories add marble bathrooms with separate shower and soaking tub · The one recurring gripe is that some TVs and furnishings are starting to show the resort's age.
"Opened the curtains in the morning to the sea and those long pools — the kids swam all day and we never had to leave. A really easy family stay."

The headline feature is three outdoor saltwater pools, including a 35-metre lap pool for anyone who wants to swim properly · There's a separate kids' pool and kids' club, which makes this resort a strong favourite with families · Quan Spa offers massages and treatments · Water sports like kayaking and snorkelling are on hand · The wide, grassy grounds give children room to run, and that's the main reason many families settle in for several nights rather than just an overnight stop.

On food, the breakfast buffet earns consistent praise for variety and quality · There's a restaurant, café and a beachside bar for an evening drink · But understand that the location is fairly remote, with few restaurants or shops outside the resort · Most guests end up eating their main meals on-site, at hotel prices · Some reviews note service can be uneven across the different outlets, though staff overall are praised as friendly and attentive.

It's roughly a three-and-a-half-hour drive from Bangkok · If you're carrying on to Koh Samet, the Ban Phe pier isn't far, so many use the resort as a base before or after the island · It scores 9.0 from 508 reviews on Trip.com · around 8.4 from 545 reviews on Booking.com · and 4.4 of 5 on TripAdvisor, ranked #1 of 4 hotels in Chak Phong — numbers that say most guests leave happy.

Honestly, Rayong Marriott isn't for people who want nightlife or a choice of restaurants outside the resort · The setting is quiet and remote; venturing out means driving · But if you're here to unwind with family, want a private beach, several pools, big sea-view rooms and dependable Marriott service — it delivers that well, at a price that's genuinely reasonable for an international-brand resort.

A tip from following the reviews here: ask for an Ocean High Floor room, because that Gulf-of-Thailand view from the balcony is the highlight · If you hold Marriott Bonvoy status, ask about upgrades and breakfast benefits · Over long weekends and high season rooms fill fast and rates climb sharply, so book ahead and lock in a free-cancellation rate first.

highlights.title: Private Wang Kaew Beach
highlights.text: A long, quiet stretch of sand right in front of the resort, walkable straight from your room — far from the busy tourist beaches.

highlights.title: Three saltwater pools
highlights.text: Including a 35-metre lap pool and a kids' pool — ideal for families who want to be in the water all day.

highlights.title: Family-friendly · Marriott standard
highlights.text: Sprawling grounds, a kids' club, spacious sea-view rooms and reliable international-chain service.

honestSummary: Rayong Marriott is the best pick in Rayong for families who want a private beach, several pools and big sea-view rooms at international-brand standard — vast grounds, all-day fun for kids, a good breakfast · Just accept that the location is fairly remote, there's little outside the resort, and parts of it are starting to age.
honestChecks: If you want nightlife or a choice of restaurants beyond your hotel — Wang Kaew Beach is quiet and remote, requiring a drive → choose somewhere in Rayong town or on a livelier beach.
If you only plan a single overnight before Koh Samet — the resort is big and full of facilities, so one night barely uses it → it suits a 2-night-plus stay to make the most of the pools and beach.
If it's a long weekend or high season and you haven't booked — sea-view rooms fill fast and rates rise sharply → book ahead and lock in a free-cancellation rate first.

faqTitle: Frequently Asked Questions — Rayong Marriott Resort & Spa

faq.q: Where is Rayong Marriott · how do you get there?
faq.a: It sits on Wang Kaew Beach in Chak Phong, Klaeng district, Rayong Province · It's about a 3.5-hour drive from Bangkok · The Ban Phe pier for Koh Samet is around 30 minutes away by car, so many guests use it as a base before or after the island.

faq.q: What are the room rates and types at Rayong Marriott?
faq.a: Rates start at approximately ฿3,500/night for a Deluxe Garden View · Above that are Deluxe Ocean View, Deluxe Ocean High Floor and Premier Panoramic King (~67 sqm) · Prices depend on dates and packages and climb sharply over long weekends, so compare a few platforms before booking.

faq.q: Is Rayong Marriott good for families?
faq.a: Very much so · It has three saltwater pools including a 35-metre lap pool, a kids' pool, a kids' club and wide grassy grounds · Rooms are spacious and many suit families · The private beach is right in front, walkable from your room — which is why many families stay several nights.

faq.q: Are there restaurants or attractions around Rayong Marriott?
faq.a: Fairly few · The location is quiet and remote, with limited restaurants or shops outside the resort, so most guests eat on-site · If you want to head out, Mae Phim Beach is about 15 minutes away and Ban Phe Market roughly 30 — a car is the easiest way to get around.

faq.q: How far in advance should I book?
faq.a: Over long weekends and high season, book 1–2 months ahead as sea-view rooms fill fast and rates climb · Most platforms offer free cancellation — pick that if your plans aren't fixed · Marriott Bonvoy members can ask about upgrades at check-in.

faq.q: What review score does Rayong Marriott have?
faq.a: It scores 9.0 from 508 reviews on Trip.com · around 8.4 from 545 reviews on Booking.com · and 4.4 of 5 on TripAdvisor, ranked #1 of 4 hotels in Chak Phong — reflecting strong satisfaction with the beach, pools and service.
